tei:div.tei:p: “The Glory of God!” written by David Nunes Carvalho was recorded with a few short bars for the melody in the Carvalho Holograph, one of the handwritten manuscripts used by the Reformed Society of Israelites as a supplement for their prayer service. Many thanks to the American Jewish Archives for providing access to the manuscript. –Aharon Varady
